audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer attributed Aurora's healing to 'Between Worlds' (spikes[0], whys[2], wants.foe[0]) and to 'Spirit Departed' (spikes[1]). Between Worlds is her R — a 250-range shockwave and slow zone she can teleport across. 'Spirit Departed' is not an ability she has. The heal is Spirit Abjuration, her passive. The page also called her level 3-5 pattern a 'stun-dash'; Across the Veil is a leap into invisibility with no stun, and her only hard CC is the level 6 ultimate.
audit.why: A player told to play around 'Between Worlds sustain' at level 3 is being told to fear an ability she does not have until 6, and to look for a stun that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Healing reattributed to Spirit Abjuration throughout; the level 3-5 pattern rebuilt on Across the Veil (22s->18s leap into invisibility) and The Weirding (15s->11s slow plus a backward hop).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Aurora/Aurora/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Diana/Diana/Aurora/Aurora/Diana/Diana/Diana. All seven rows disagreed with the sentence beside them.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 Diana matches her 900 range with a shield and she has no escape yet; 3-5 flip once Across the Veil and The Weirding exist and her passive heals the chip; Moonfall at 6 and item burst flip it back, matching 54.95% over 1,252 games.
audit.corrected: phases[0..1].side = Diana, phases[2..3].side = Aurora, phases[4..6].side = Diana, with phases[0..3].why rewritten to match.

audit.why: Level 2 Across the Veil, level 3-5 her trading window, level 6 Moonfall against her 140s Between Worlds, then first item. The ultimate cooldown gap (100s versus 140s at rank 1) is the concrete spike the page never gave.
